notes.title: Controller Support Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p]The time has come! Controller Support has been added for all player actions and "most" menu actions. The options menu slider does not support controller input but everything else should. Along with this update, many changes have been made to most systems in the game including resource management, combat, teleport logic, movement tracking, boss balancing, spell animations, etc.

Basically, this is a HUGE update that will be the base for all future updates and expansion into the final form of The Old One.

Thank you for all of the support. Please use the feedback link in the game to let me know what you think of it.[/p]

notes.title: Currently 111% Funded, 20 hours left to back on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p]We are now in the last 24 hours of the Kickstarter Campaign. Jump in now for your last chance at quite a few physical rewards. I can't believe we have surpassed 100% funded and kept going. This was such an incredible experience I can't thank you enough for wanting to support this little passion project.

Thank you for your support and I look forward to sharing regular updates about the progress of the game up to release![/p]

notes.title: One more step! 96% Funded on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everybody!

Today is a super exciting day. It is VERY possible that our Kickstarter crosses the 100% funded mark in its campaign. This has been MONTHS in the making, and I want to thank each and every person that has tried the demo, shared a post, talked to a friend, backed the project, and more.

Thank you for helping take this idea of mine and truly turn it into a reality. I'm excited to share future plans of the project, new areas, enemies, characters, and more, in the coming weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning and I'm happy to have all of you on board with us![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Michael[/p][p]Solo Developer of The Old One[/p]

notes.title: The Old One Kickstarter Reaches 85% Funding!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello again![/b]  Thank you for wishlisting, following, and supporting this game. I am constantly blown away but the kindness and generosity of our little community. Right now, we have less than $750 to raise before we reach the funding goal over on Kickstarter. This is a HUGE milestone for the project and will help tremendously in getting this project completed. If you would like to support the game and help us reach our goal, please check out the campaign page: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/creativewaste/the-old-one-a-cosmic-horror-action-platformer?ref=user_menu"]The Old One Kickstarter Campaign[/url]

The demo and campaign have only been live for 11 days and already we have less than 1k to go on funding, and our wishlists just exceeded 200! This is a wild fact that I am still working through processing. Thank you so much for support indie games and indie developers. It means the world and I can't wait to share a finished adventure with you at the end of this journey.

Thank you, Shphrd - Solo Dev of The Old One[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter Reaches 50% Funding Goal in 72 Hours!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everybody![/b]

I hope you've been enjoying the demo. If you have any feedback on your experiences, please let me know by filling out the feedback form by clicking the FEEDBACK button in-game.

I have some awesome news I wanted to share about the future of the game. As some of you know, we are currently seeking funding over at: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/creativewaste/the-old-one-a-cosmic-horror-action-platformer?ref=user_menu]The Old One Kickstarter Campaign[/url]

This was launched on Sunday and as of right now, it has surpassed 50% of the funding goal! Thank you so much for all the support and I look forward to sharing more dev updates and more in the future!

Thank you,
Shphrd - Solo Dev of The Old One

notes.title: The Old One has LAUNCHED on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
The time has come to launch the Kickstarter! It's been live since this morning, and it has already raised 25% of the final funding goal!

Thank you for all the support! If you would like to back the project, please go to the link below and see all of your options.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/creativewaste/the-old-one-a-cosmic-horror-action-platformer][b]The Old One Kickstarter
[/b][/url]
Apart from the Kickstarter, the steam demo has also launched! Why not take the game for a spin before deciding if you back it! There is also a feedback form in the demo and any feedback would help tremendously in the development process.

Thank you for wishlisting, sharing, backing, and playing The Old One. I can't wait to share more development updates with you, and I'll keep you posted on how the campaign goes.

notes.title: Public Demo + Kickstarter Launch on June 1st!
notes.notes:
The time has come! I've been hard at work on this current demo build since April of this and I can't wait to share my progress with everyone! This doesn't just mark the launch of an early preview demo though. I am also launching a Kickstarter to help me fund this project so I can work on it full time for the remainder of the year.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/creativewaste/the-old-one-a-cosmic-horror-action-platformer]The Old One Kickstarter Page[/url]

I'm looking forward to hearing what people think of the game, and I can't wait to share this project with everyone in just a few short days.

Thank you for all the support so far and I appreciate you taking the time to check out my steam page.

notes.title: Wishlists breaks 100! & Playtest Sign-ups Open!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everybody! This is our first update post on the steam page![/b]

Thank you so much for wishlisting, sharing the page, and supporting this project. This has been a wild journey since November of last year and I can't believe the progress I've made. There are a lot of exciting announcements on the way but first, we need to talk about that play test button up there.

I didn't realize the playtest has to be approved separately so there is a little bit of a delay on that front! Fingers crossed Steam approved the playtest build soon so I can start sending out invites to people.

If you don't get in this short playtest round, don't worry, a public demo is releasing around June 1st (along with something else) that will have fixes from this playtest on it. Thank you for checking out The Old One and I can't wait to share more info with everyone soon!

Thank you,
Michael
[i]Solo Developer of The Old One[/i]
